title: TON_IoT Network Flow Model Input
description: Versioned feature contract for the current binary network-flow classifier. Null values represent unavailable telemetry and are passed to the fitted preprocessing pipeline for imputation.

event_id.description: Optional source event or flow identifier for tracing; never a model feature.

observed_at.description: Optional UTC observation time for serving and downstream ordering; never a model feature.

service.description: Detected application service; Zeek conn.log service. Preserve absence as null.

src_bytes.description: Originator payload bytes; Zeek conn.log orig_bytes.

dst_bytes.description: Responder payload bytes; Zeek conn.log resp_bytes.

missed_bytes.description: Content bytes missed by analyzers; Zeek conn.log missed_bytes.

src_pkts.description: Originator packet count; Zeek conn.log orig_pkts.

src_ip_bytes.description: Originator IP-layer bytes; Zeek conn.log orig_ip_bytes.

dst_pkts.description: Responder packet count; Zeek conn.log resp_pkts.

dst_ip_bytes.description: Responder IP-layer bytes; Zeek conn.log resp_ip_bytes.

dns_qclass.description: DNS query class; enrich from Zeek dns.log by connection uid.

dns_qtype.description: DNS query type; enrich from Zeek dns.log by connection uid.

dns_rcode.description: DNS response code; enrich from Zeek dns.log by connection uid.

dns_AA.description: DNS authoritative-answer flag in the dataset's T/F representation; enrich from dns.log.

dns_RD.description: DNS recursion-desired flag in the dataset's T/F representation; enrich from dns.log.

dns_RA.description: DNS recursion-available flag in the dataset's T/F representation; enrich from dns.log.

dns_rejected.description: DNS rejection flag in the dataset's T/F representation; enrich from dns.log.

ssl_version.description: TLS protocol version; enrich from Zeek ssl.log version.

ssl_cipher.description: Negotiated TLS cipher; enrich from Zeek ssl.log cipher.

ssl_resumed.description: TLS session-resumption flag in the dataset's T/F representation; enrich from ssl.log.

ssl_established.description: TLS-established flag in the dataset's T/F representation; enrich from ssl.log.

http_trans_depth.description: HTTP transaction depth; enrich from Zeek http.log trans_depth.

http_method.description: HTTP request method; enrich from Zeek http.log method.

http_version.description: HTTP version represented numerically as in the training CSV; parse Zeek http.log version consistently.

http_request_body_len.description: HTTP request body bytes; enrich from Zeek http.log request_body_len.

http_response_body_len.description: HTTP response body bytes; enrich from Zeek http.log response_body_len.

http_status_code.description: HTTP response status code; enrich from Zeek http.log status_code.

weird_notice.description: Zeek weird-event notice flag in the dataset's T/F representation; enrich from weird.log and confirm source semantics for the deployed Zeek version.
